provenance.note: F-Class Open (D.23.1) and F-Class Target Rifle (D.23.2, Teil D, PDF pp. 220 to 221, .223 Remington and .308 Winchester, scored separately) share distances, shots and faces. Distances are 300 to 1000 m in 100 m steps nationally and 300 to 1200 yd abroad by announcement, the record holds the longest national distance.
